form.title: Create guardrail
form.guardrailNamePlaceholder: Enter a name for this guardrail
form.modeHint: How the guardrail should be applied
form.alwaysOnHint: If enabled, this guardrail will be applied to all requests by default.
form.skipSystemMessageHint: Unified guardrails only: omit role: system from guardrail evaluation input (OpenAI chat + Anthropic messages). The model still receives full messages. Use global default follows litellm_settings.skip_system_message_in_guardrail.
form.skipToolMessageHint: Unified guardrails only: omit role: tool from guardrail evaluation input (OpenAI chat + Anthropic messages). The model still receives full messages. Use global default follows litellm_settings.skip_tool_message_in_guardrail.

modeDescriptions.preCall: Before LLM Call - Runs before the LLM call and checks the input (Recommended)
modeDescriptions.duringCall: During LLM Call - Runs in parallel with the LLM call, with response held until check completes
modeDescriptions.postCall: After LLM Call - Runs after the LLM call and checks only the output
modeDescriptions.loggingOnly: Logging Only - Only runs on logging callbacks without affecting the LLM call
modeDescriptions.preMcpCall: Before MCP Tool Call - Runs before MCP tool execution and validates tool calls
modeDescriptions.duringMcpCall: During MCP Tool Call - Runs in parallel with MCP tool execution for monitoring
modeDescriptions.postMcpCall: After MCP Tool Call - Runs after MCP tool execution and checks the tool result

endpoint.description: Configure settings for a specific call type. Most guardrails don't need this — skip it unless you're using a specific endpoint like /v1/realtime.
endpoint.endSessionAfterHint: Automatically close the session after this many guardrail violations. Leave empty to never auto-close.
endpoint.warnHint: Bot speaks the message, session continues
endpoint.endSessionHint: Bot speaks the message, connection closes immediately
endpoint.violationMessageHint: What the bot says aloud when this guardrail fires. Falls back to the default violation message if empty.
